title: SafeTune: Search-based Harmfulness Minimisation for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and the mitigation of harmfulness (specifically toxic, dangerous, or illegal content). While it includes 'unethical' content in its definition of harmfulness, the core of the evaluation and the prompts used (e.g., malware creation, password theft) pertain to safety guardrails and alignment rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, philosophical ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning.
